fixtures.name: redelete_redone_run
fixtures.description: Undo restores a deleted run as a redone copy; a delete set inside the deleted original then leaves it whole; redo and undo follow.

fixtures.name: redelete_start_inside_supplementary
fixtures.description: A delete set starting inside a deleted emoji (clocks 1-2) leaves it whole, so undo and redo restore and delete the emoji itself.

fixtures.name: redelete_end_inside_supplementary
fixtures.description: A delete set ending inside a deleted emoji (clocks 1-2) leaves it whole, so undo and redo restore and delete the emoji itself.

fixtures.name: cascade_into_supplementary
fixtures.description: A delete set from a nested text's container into its emoji deletes the container first; the cascade deletes the text, so its range end does not split the emoji.

fixtures.name: two_ranges
fixtures.description: One delete set with two ranges: the first ends inside the live run "abcdefgh" (clocks 0-7), which splits; the second lies inside the deleted run at clocks 8-10, which stays whole.
